title: Clicks, Carbon, and Risk: Climate Attention, Persistent Financial Risk, and Real-Sector Activity
abstract: arXiv:2611.22517v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Do shifts in public climate concern alter persistent financial risk and subsequently matter for real activity? We combine daily U.S. sectoral equity returns with a monthly Climate Concern Index (CCI) constructed from internet search intensity and decomposed into adverse and transition-oriented components. GARCH-MIDAS estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity: adverse climate concern raises persistent volatility in carbon-intensive Energy activities, while transition-oriented attention tends to reduce persistent volatility in regulated Utilities, with important differences across sub-sectors. We then construct a persistent-risk differential between Energy and Utilities and examine its predictive content for sectoral real activity using local projections. Innovations associated with adverse climate concern precede declines in Oil and Gas industrial production and employment over the following quarters, while comparable Utilities responses

translated_title: 点击、碳与风险：气候关注度、持续性金融风险与实体经济活动
translated_abstract: 公众气候担忧的变化是否会改变持续性金融风险，并进而对实体经济活动产生影响？我们将美国行业股票日收益率与月度气候关注度指数（CCI）相结合，该指数基于互联网搜索强度构建，并被分解为不利型（adverse）和转型导向型（transition-oriented）两个组成部分。GARCH-MIDAS估计结果显示出显著的异质性：不利型气候担忧会推高碳密集型能源行业的持续性波动率，而转型导向型关注则倾向于降低受监管公用事业行业的持续性波动率，且各子行业之间存在重要差异。随后，我们构建了能源与公用事业之间的持续性风险差异指标，并利用局部投影方法考察其对行业实体经济活动的预测能力。与不利型气候担忧相关的新息在随后的几个季度中先于石油和天然气工业生产及就业的下降，而公用事业行业的类似反应……
tldr: 本文基于互联网搜索构建气候关注度指数，发现不利型气候担忧会推高能源行业的长期波动并预示油气行业生产与就业的下滑，而转型导向型关注则降低公用事业行业的长期波动，揭示了气候情绪从金融市场向实体经济的传导机制。
en_tdlr: Using a search-based Climate Concern Index with GARCH-MIDAS and local projections, this paper shows that adverse climate concern raises persistent volatility in Energy and precedes declines in Oil and Gas production and employment, while transition-oriented attention reduces persistent volatility in Utilities.
